summary: Slide thumbnail feature testing completed successfully. All core functionality is working as expected. Thumbnails render miniature versions of slide elements (text, images, shapes, video placeholders, buttons) in the left sidebar. The feature uses CSS transform: scale() to fit a 960x540 canvas into the thumbnail container.
passed_tests: ✅ Slide thumbnails render in left sidebar (4-11 slides verified across 3 projects)
✅ Thumbnails show miniature versions of slide elements (text, images, video, shapes)
✅ Thumbnails show correct background color for slides
✅ Slide number badge appears at bottom-left when elements exist
✅ Slide number centered for slides without elements
✅ Editor loads without console errors related to thumbnail rendering
✅ Slide selection works - clicking slide changes active state
✅ Dropdown menu shows Duplicar (duplicate) and Excluir (delete) options
✅ Add new slide creates empty thumbnail with centered number
✅ PPT-imported slides in SCORMIFY - V2 (11 slides) display correctly
✅ Manual slides in Demo SCORMIFY videos (4 slides) display correctly
✅ Teste Multiplos audios project (2 slides) displays correctly
✅ Drag handle visible on hover for slide reordering
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ SlideThumbnailContent component (lines 139-270) correctly renders all element types: text, image, shape, video, button, html, quiz
✅ SortableSlideItem component (lines 273-392) uses ResizeObserver to dynamically calculate thumbnail scale
✅ Scale calculation: thumbScale = containerWidth / (slideWidth || 960) - ensures proper aspect ratio
✅ Elements rendered at original pixel positions with CSS transform: scale(thumbScale) applied to container
✅ Slide background color/image correctly applied: slide.background || '#fff' and backgroundImage url
✅ Conditional rendering: hasElements shows SlideThumbnailContent + small badge, else shows centered number
✅ getThumbAssetUrl helper properly resolves asset URLs including cross-domain assets
✅ data-testid='slide-{index}' present on all slide thumbnails for testing
✅ CSS .slide-thumbnail class has aspect-video ratio maintaining 16:9 proportions

context_for_next_testing_agent: Slide thumbnail feature is working correctly. The implementation uses a SlideThumbnailContent component that renders slide elements at their original pixel positions inside a scaled-down container using CSS transform: scale(). The scale factor is dynamically calculated based on the actual thumbnail container width via ResizeObserver (line 293). Tested across 3 projects with different content types - all rendering correctly.
